card.title: Put It Back Quietly
card.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put your umbrella back in the stand. You'll want it for work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it wet? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I gave it a rinse. I'll dry the handle before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's pondweed caught in the spokes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it needs another rinse. Have breakfast; I'll get it back in the stand properly this time.

mechanism: A restores a wet umbrella while repeatedly offering cleanup to avoid explaining the pond evidence.
confusable: Unlike openly repairing damage, A must keep the reason restoration was necessary concealed.
comparison: D37-a removes physical clues by another rinse; D37-b replaces a whole set to prevent counting the missing originals.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
